item.title: On The PSC Podcast
item.description:
I had the pleasure recently to be on The PSC in Conversation with Antonio Weiss, a Senior Partner at The PSC and former local councillor. As announced on the podcast, I’ve recently started working with The PSC as a senior AI expert advisor.

It was great to talk AI with Antonio, whose recent AI Demystified book was published by the FT and was an Amazon bestseller. I look forward to the second edition that comes out soon.
